name: VT Designer
tagline: Simulate elevator traffic across a high-rise and check car counts against Indian handling-capacity targets.
description: Runs an isometric elevator-traffic simulation across a building's low/mid/high-rise zones, verifies car counts against Indian handling-capacity targets, checks fire and monsoon compliance settings, and exports a client report.

page.objective: Confirm a tower's elevator provisioning is adequate before it becomes a costly retrofit.
page.problem: Verifying elevator car counts against handling-capacity targets, zone by zone, is normally a manual traffic calculation.
page.solution: A building's floor and population program drives a live traffic simulation, and each zone is scored adequate or under-lifted against Indian handling-capacity targets.

highlights.headline: Isometric elevator-traffic simulation with pass/fail verdicts per zone.
points: Runs a live isometric traffic simulation across low/mid/high-rise zones.
Flags each zone adequate or under-lifted, with a suggested car count where it fails.
Checks fire and monsoon compliance settings specific to the Indian context.
